response.sql: WITH country_averages AS (SELECT c.country, AVG(cs.points) AS average_points, AVG(cs.wins) AS average_wins FROM circuits AS c LEFT JOIN races AS r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId LEFT JOIN constructorStandings AS cs ON cs.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY c.country) SELECT country, average_points, average_wins, average_wins - (SELECT AVG(average_wins) FROM country_averages) AS wins_difference FROM country_averages ORDER BY country;
